title: User Login Fails with Valid Credentials – Authentication Service Error
description:
Issue:
Users are unable to log in to the application even when they provide the correct username and password.When a registered user enters valid login credentials and clicks the Login button, the application sends the authentication request to the backend. Instead of successfully authenticating the user and redirecting them to the dashboard, the request fails with an internal server error.

The issue occurs intermittently, but it is more frequently observed when multiple users attempt to log in at the same time. The authentication service appears to fail while retrieving the user's account details from the database.

title: Payment API Fails with Gateway Timeout During Transaction
description:
When a user attempts to complete a payment, the Payment API occasionally fails
with a gateway timeout error. The payment request is sent successfully from
the frontend, but the backend does not receive a response from the external
payment gateway within the configured timeout period.

As a result, the transaction is marked as failed and the user sees an
"Unable to process payment" message.

The issue is mainly observed when the payment gateway response is delayed
due to high network latency or temporary gateway load.

Expected Result:
The payment should either complete successfully when the gateway responds,
or the system should handle the timeout gracefully without incorrectly
marking the transaction as failed.

Actual Result:
The Payment API returns a 504 Gateway Timeout error and the payment is
shown as failed.
